notes.title: Papa Bear Thinks Chog’s Tyranny is a Load of Carp
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/276147b0a0c77c4280d4c287b06b3d19ebeaa7c8.png[/img]

[h1]Meet Lucio[/h1]
Lucio the Bear hails from a quiet little Italian town, but the time for hibernation is over. He believes it’s important to know the facts about Team B.ARK so you don't fall for the Dark Tide’s propaganda videos hook, line, and sinker.

[previewyoutube=fjazK9PulXg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]How He Plays[/h2]
Come to the rescue of injured comrades with Lucio’s helpful shield ship, Mossy Pig II. Protect the entire crew with Mossy Pig II’s super attack, Bear Hug, which grows in size with each fusion to envelope multiple teammates in his shield’s safe embrace.

[h2]Backstory[/h2]
Adopted as a cub by the kind-hearted Ricci family, they accepted Lucio as one of their own by teaching him the family fishing business. He loved spending his afternoons out at sea with the family, sharing one whale-of-a-tale after another before returning home to his favorite dish: a hot plate of freshly baked pizza. When a tragic attack from the invading Dark Tide overturned all the fishing vessels and flooded his village, he joined B.ARK to help stop the ensuing violence and restore peace among the planets. Lucio is stepping up and taking the lead with Team B.ARK to bring justice to all friends and family lost at sea.

notes.title: It’s Dark Tide Season for This Rabbit
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/e3b0faa9995d6136f9cd0c728dc8410bff27c5d7.png[/img]

[h1]Meet Marv[/h1]
Marv the Rabbit usually spends his days frolicking with his 37 siblings, but the annual family high-jump competition has been indefinitely postponed. Gill Flounder’s latest propaganda broadcast claims Marv is a pink speed demon. . . and he’s absolutely right! Be afraid. Be very afraid (no...not you, Marv.)

[previewyoutube=KMz5f6IOaA4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]How He Plays[/h2]
His ship, Lucky 7, is the quickest of the bunch and comes equipped with inescapable homing missiles. Put a big bullseye on Chog’s Army with Lucky 7’s super attack, Fearful Focus, which slows down all enemies on screen.

[h2]Backstory[/h2]
As the smallest member of Team B.ARK, Marv is no stranger to needing pep in his step to survive. In his Nevada desert hometown, he was often prey to the wildlife and spent most of his time in his family’s cozy desert burrows. When the invading Dark Tide eventually found its way deep underground in the form of terrifying drilling bots, Marv’s fleeing family was separated in the chaos. In a desperate attempt to escape the uprooting of his home, Marv dug faster than he’d ever dug before... and landed inside a secret B.ARK facility! With his family’s continued survival on the line, Marv joined the B.ARK Team to go from scaredy cat (sorry Felicity!) to rabbit champ. Hop through enemy fire with the quick reflexes of this anxious little rabbit and show the Dark Tide size doesn’t matter when your family’s on the line.

notes.title: Chog Beware: This Kitty Bites!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/2898ba45d217d1c03209937bb3b4b7600f09e177.png[/img]

[h1]Meet Felicity[/h1]
Felicity the Cat is here to chew some catnip and trash enemy robots, and she’s all out of catnip. Have you seen the latest Dark Tide propaganda video? Gill Flounders is right about one thing: Chog’s Army should fear “Machine Gun” Felicity and her devastating drive for victory!

[previewyoutube=zEVjOA-5p0I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]How She Plays[/h2]
Her ship, Payback, is equipped with a powerful spread shot. Destroy all in your path with Payback’s super attack, Cat’s Gaze, which maximizes firepower into multiple rows of devastating bullets. Completing her mission means never having to say, “I’m out of ammo.” 

[h2]Backstory[/h2]
As a former stray cat with no familial connections, Felicity has spent her life fending for herself on the mean streets of Paris. Despite her habit of running solo, she joined the B.ARK Team as an opportunity to fight for more than just the Solar System—she’s bent on settling an old score! Betrayed by her best friend, Bubbles the Goldfish, Felicity clings to the promise of finding him and finally enacting revenge. Taking down Chog comes second to using Bubbles’ mech as her scratching post. This wise-cracking kitty is ready to charge right into the thick of things, tear through her enemies, and hopefully be back before naptime.

notes.title: Dark Tide is No Match for This Good Boy
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/ceea580245a989305eaa4885460f602404859a6e.png[/img]

[h1]Meet Barker[/h1]
Barker the Dog may be small and drooly, but he’s off his leash and ready to help the B.ARK Team blast their way to victory. Don’t fall for the Dark Tide’s malicious propaganda video! Peanut butter may be Barker’s weakness, but that’s only because he tends to eat so much it gives him a belly ache.

[previewyoutube=-ReEKyAKXBY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]How He plays[/h2]
His sturdy ship, Wishbone, has extra firepower from up to three tiny helpers. Take out entire waves of foes with Wishbone’s super attack, Bullet Stream, which launches huge projectiles at an increased fire rate.

[h2]Backstory[/h2]
Having grown up with his kind and caring owner Milla, Barker has known nothing but belly rubs and long games of fetch. After Milla is taken prisoner by the invading Dark Tide, this powerful pup’s love for her fuels him with the determination needed to take on anything the enemy throws his way. Together with the rest of the team, Barker is ready to show Chog’s Army his bark is just as fierce as his bite.
